documents.title: Notice Of The 19Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company To Be Held On September 25, 2026
Newspaper Publication Of Notice And Intimation Regarding 19Th Annual General Meeting

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong financial and operational results for Q1FY27, achieving revenue of INR 1,555 crores and an EBITDA margin of 35%. The company's order book strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt with fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt during the quarter. Management highlighted record production across solar modules and cells, along with ongoing progress on the 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon expansion. Furthermore, the company outlined medium-term plans for backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing. Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching INR 15,555 million and PAT growing to INR 3,803 million.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately INR 2,400 crore of EBITDA by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflows from the C&I demand are expected to be supplied towards the later part of the financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: On the C&I demand order inflows, that's something that we've already started seeing, but the supply of it is something that you should expect towards later part of this financial year and not immediately.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for a manufacturer like them has been strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand outlook for a manufacturer like us has been strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector for a long time.
demand_outlook.quote: And C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector in a long time, which you can see is similarly growing in our case as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continues to progress according to plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continue to progress according to plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the expansion is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Following expansion completion, total manufacturing capacity is expected to reach approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells.
capex_expansion.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed ingot and wafer facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt in FY2029 and 4 gigawatt in FY2030.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that they have initiated plans for a new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: We have initiated plans for our new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that payment for land allotment at Devanahalli, Bengaluru has been completed and the land is in the company's possession.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also completed payment for land allotment at Devanahalli, Bengaluru and the land is now in the company’s possession.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they intend to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt in phases.
capex_expansion.quote: And with that, we intend to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt integrating us fully in phases.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that construction has started and orders for module lines have been finalized for the 6 gigawatt integrated capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with respect to the current expansion plan of 6 gigawatt integrated capacity. We have progressed where our construction has started and order for module line has been finalized.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin improved to 24% due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter, due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per watt is guided around INR 2.5 per watt for modules and INR 6.0 to 6.5 per watt for cells.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA per watt, I think what we had guided is around INR 2.5 per watt for just module, and for the cell it is of INR 6.00-6.5 per watt.

margins_costs.claim: DCR module margins are stated to be usually INR 8.5 to INR 9 per watt.
margins_costs.quote: So, DCR module is usually INR 8.5 to INR 9 per watt.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar module production stood at 970 megawatt while solar cell production increased to 454 megawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Solar module production stood at 970 megawatt compared to 635 megawatt in Q1FY26 and 952 megawatt in Q4 FY26. This represents year-on-year growth of 53%. Solar cell production increased to 454 megawatt compared to 360 megawatt in Q1FY26 and 428 megawatt in Q4 FY26, representing year-on-year growth of 26%.

orders_capacity.claim: Cell capacity utilization improved further to 83% compared to 68% in Q1FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Cell capacity utilization improved further to 83% compared to 68% in Q1FY26 and 79% in Q4 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow during Q1FY27 stood at 1,484 megawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our inflow during Q1FY27 stood at 1,484 megawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow for Q1 FY27 was 1,484 MW.
Management reported an order book of 9.4 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: We closed the financial year with revenue of INR 5,049 crores, EBITDA of INR 1,734 crores, PAT of INR 1,082 crores and an order book of 9.4 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that for Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at a cost of less than 8% for the expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital expenditure for the backward integration into ingot and wafer is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capital expenditure for the same is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they raised INR 2,900 crores through an IPO and public listing in November 2025, including INR 2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We completed our IPO and public listing in November 2025, raising INR2,900 crores, including INR2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they used approximately INR 1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: We used approximately INR1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that net debt to equity stood at negative 0.06x as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our net debt to equity stood at negative 0.06x.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company maintains raw material inventory strategically due to geopolitical issues taking place.
risks_headwinds.quote: Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place.

management_commitments.claim: The module line for the 6-gigawatt integrated facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed ingot and wafer facility has 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the module line for the 6 gigawatt expansion is expected to be commissioned by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: and we expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year and the cell line getting commissioned at the end of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that total installed capacity will reach 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of the FY27 financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Once completed, this will take our total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027 financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they plan to set up their first ingot and wafer facility in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
